notes.title: Major Update + Teaser!
notes.content:
First and foremost we would like to thank everyone who had wish-listed this game, for those were intrigued and patient.

In the recent months the game had undergone major changes in concept and instead of what was previously premiered, it will now become a project of a much smaller scale, with different game mechanics, look and feel.

There is still hope for the game's future in terms of the previous concept (Mechas) and it is more than likely to appear either as a major content update or in a different title.

The new project's scope will allow Atom & Evil indie game studio to finish and polish the game for your entertainment while significantly reducing the wait time for release.

Future updates will be made in regarding to release date(s), improvements and updates of the game's development.

A new teaser has been published!
